items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I lost track of Chit for awhile. He was - he did finally go out on the road with a singer and the last time I saw Chitison he was doing very well

ctx.x: That's right, my two sides are on it and a few things on there by Herman Chitison.
That's right, when I was looking through their 78's - they also recorded some bee-bop musicians. Dizzy Gillespie made in 1945 . . .
